Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
"Michel BRIAND" <media...@calva.net> writes:
> If a minion uses a melee weapon, can it uses a hand strike to increase his

>weapon damage ??

>example : with a weapon "hand strike"
>or Bang Nak (" +2 hand damage with each strike") + Undead Strength

No. But he can increase the hand damage (upon which most melee weapon's
damage is based) with hand damage modifiers (like Fists of Death).

He can also boost the melee weapon's damage with melee weapon damage
modifiers (like Undead Strength, which states explicitly that it can be
used as either a bossted hand strike or a boosted melee weapon strike)
--

Messages.Author: Wallpaper Paste
Messages.Body:
Michel BRIAND (media...@calva.net) wrote:
: If a minion uses a melee weapon, can it uses a hand strike to increase his

: weapon damage ??

: example : with a weapon "hand strike"
: or Bang Nak (" +2 hand damage with each strike") + Undead Strength

: --

: Michel BRIAND
: Toulouse, FRANCE
: media...@calva.net

Undead Strength, Mighty Grapple (superior), and Growing Fury,
for example, all state "use your hand or melee weapon for +X
damage," so they would increase damage done by Bang Nakh,
Bastard Sword, and Sengir Dagger, ie. Cards such as Burning
Wrath could not modify it, though, and indeed are strikes to
themselves, so could not be used with melee weapons.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
da...@schwartz.manawatu.gen.nz (David Schwartz) writes:

>Can Torn Signpost be combined with a weapon? What about Wolf Claws?

Torn signpost simply sets the vampire's base hand damage to a new amount.

If a weapon deals damage based on base hand damage, the it will
be based on the new hand damage amount.

If you use a simple hand strike (for the new amount), then you may
change all of that damage to aggravated via Claws.
